description: The security posture of many current AI products is failing at fundamental levels expected of enterprise software, making them vulnerable to criminal exploitation.

instances.assertion: The security posture of many current AI products is failing at fundamental levels expected of enterprise software, making them vulnerable to criminal exploitation.
Criminal gangs are finding that basic information security postures in AI products are failing at fundamental levels.
Criminal gangs and attackers are exploiting fundamental security failures in enterprise AI products.
